| Item | Survey Question Wording | Scale Endpoints (1, 4, 7) | Theoretical Construct |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Item 1 | The best art has a clear political point of view | 1: Strongly disagree, 4: Neither agree nor disagree, 7: Strongly agree | Politicized Aesthetic Content |
| Item 2 | The best art has a clear moral point of view | 1: Strongly disagree, 4: Neither agree nor disagree, 7: Strongly agree | Moralized Aesthetic Content |
| Item 3 | The best art makes us think about what is right and wrong in new ways | 1: Strongly disagree, 4: Neither agree nor disagree, 7: Strongly agree | Moral Reflexivity / Ethical Engagement |
| Item 4 | The best art doesn't pick political sides and makes us think about politics in new ways | 1: Strongly disagree, 4: Neither agree nor disagree, 7: Strongly agree | Political Pluralism / Content Autonomy |
| Item 5 | It's wrong to appreciate music or art created by people who act poorly or hold objectionable beliefs | 1: Strongly disagree, 4: Neither agree nor disagree, 7: Strongly agree | Creator Moral Censure / Cancel Culture |
| Item 6 | I avoid engaging with art and music created by those who publicly endorse political candidates and policies that I do not support | 1: Strongly disagree, 4: Neither agree nor disagree, 7: Strongly agree | Political Polarization Avoidance |
| Item 7 | I like it when my tastes are different or unique from other people | 1: Strongly disagree, 4: Neither agree nor disagree, 7: Strongly agree | Aesthetic Distinction / Uniqueness |
| Item 8 | On a scale from 'entirely entertaining and enjoyable' (1) to 'entirely difficult and challenging' (7), what kind of art and media do you like? | 1: Entirely entertaining/enjoyable, 4: Equally balanced, 7: Entirely difficult/challenging | Highbrow Intellectual Formalism |
| Item 9 | Thinking about comedy, on a scale from 'The only goal is to create laughter' (1) to 'The only goal is to say something' (7), what do you think the goal is for the best comedy? | 1: Only goal is laughter, 4: Equal goals, 7: Only goal is to say something important | Serious vs. Popular Comedy |
| Item 10 | How frequently do you ironically consume music, TV shows, or movies? (i.e., consume something to laugh at it, or because it's 'so bad it's good') | 1: Never at all, 3: Sometimes, 5: Very frequently | Ironic / Detached Consumption |
